about_the_game:
🎯 Become the Master Gunsmith of the Wild West!
In Armory Simulator, immerse yourself in the captivating and unforgiving world of the Wild West, where every bullet counts, and every customer has a story to tell. Your mission? Build, manage, and expand your own armory, catering to the needs of cowboys, bounty hunters, and outlaws seeking the finest equipment.

Key Features:

💼 Manage Your Shop:

  • Buy, sell, and trade a wide variety of firearms, ammunition, accessories, and customizable items.

  • Grow your business by decorating your shop and attracting a diverse clientele with smart marketing strategies.

🤠 A Dynamic World:

  • Interact with a colorful cast of characters, from sheriffs seeking reliable guns to outlaws looking to defend themselves against bounty hunters.

  • Make choices that shape your reputation: will you be a respected arms dealer or the preferred supplier for bandits?

🌵 Immersive Wild West Experience:

  • Enjoy an authentic atmosphere with dusty landscapes, lively saloons, and a soundtrack straight out of the Wild West.

  • Face challenges such as stock management and the unpredictable life of the frontier.

A Unique Adventure in the Wild West

Armory Simulator is not just a management game: it’s an adventure in a world where every choice matters. Can you build a thriving business and survive this unforgiving environment?

🕰️ Sharpen your rifles, load your pistols, and open the doors to your armory. The Wild West is waiting for you!

Add Armory Simulator to your wishlist now and get ready for a one-of-a-kind adventure in the Wild West!

name: ARMORY SIMULATOR

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: WINDOWS 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: I5 3350 / RYZEN 5 2500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 / AMD R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: WINDOWS 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: I5 7600K / RYZEN 5 2600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
